findings.location: source.html — paragraph discussing germination (uses English in parentheses)
findings.source_quote: We’re not talking about a dormant sleep, where we are unaware of our surroundings, but rather a germinating sleep. Germination has two components.
findings.suggested_fix: Remove the English parenthetical term and provide a fully Urdu rendering of the technical term. Replace “ابھار پانے (germination)” with just “ابھار پانے والا عمل” or “جِرمینیشن (ابھار پانا)” — preferably the former for fully Urdu text. Preserve existing HTML tags and sentence order. Example: “ہم … بلکہ ایک ابھار پانے والی نیند کی بات کر رہے ہیں۔ ابھار پانے کے عمل کی دو جز ہیں۔”
